samples.summary: Only `itemAbove`'s depth comparison is tested across a bare `>` separator; `parentOf`'s identical change (outdent) has no test
samples.evidence: The delta changes both `itemAbove` (list-commands.ts:159) and `parentOf` (list-commands.ts:173) from `prev.quote !== p.quote` to a depth comparison. The new test 'nests across the blank separator of a loose quoted list' (list-commands.test.ts:261-270) exercises only the indent/`itemAbove` path (asserts canIndent and the indented result). No test in the suite outdents a nested quoted item whose parent is separated from it by a bare `>` line (e.g. `> - a\n>\n>   - b` then outdentList), so `parentOf`'s new behaviour — finding the shallower parent across the bare `>` rather than bailing out — could regress silently to the old prefix-text semantics without any test failing. Searched: list-commands.test.ts in full; grep for `blockquote|loose|quoteDepth` across packages/notes/src (only preview/checkbox tests match, none exercise outdent in quotes).
